review.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed/functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable limitations, 10 exceptional with minimal observed friction. Holistic judgment of observed emulated mobile slice; wins are not a quality grade.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent complete mission, strong mood, clear objective progression and useful touch assists, offset by dense small HUD text and limited confidence in manual precision.
reasons.controls: Large labeled buttons, tap aim, route and TURN work visibly; manual stick responded. Combined manual movement/fire was less precise, and free aim coverage is too brief for strong claims.
reasons.gameplay: Recovering three named memories, timed coil windows and deck upload form an understandable sequence. Threats and cover create decisions, but most travel used route assist and broader combat depth remains unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Rainy dark industrial setting, cyan lighting, copper coils, weapon animation and restrained result screen give a cohesive atmosphere. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Dynamic route/approach labels, SAVED confirmations, map pause and START FRESH are useful. Handbook needs scrolling at 390px height; feedback can change from success to cover before next inspection.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, main objectives, coil percentages and results are legible. Small amber labels, distant enemies/optics, thin map details and stacked banners require close inspection.

review.enjoyment: Atmosphere and visible objective completion were satisfying within paused observations; sustained continuous enjoyment and unplayed content are unassessed.

review.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but playable with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable limitations, 9 excellent with minor friction, 10 exceptional across the assessed scope. Holistic judgment, not a win-rate grade or average of subscores.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent, attractive short mission with effective touch assistance and clear progress feedback. Precision/occlusion friction and limited combat depth observed on the assisted path hold the grade below excellent. Two wins alone do not determine the grade.
reasons.controls: Manual forward stick moved visibly; tap aim, FIRE, FIRE drag, AIM and simultaneous ROUTE/FIRE worked in sampled cases. TURN worked when inspected separately, but first TURN/FIRE batch failed to visibly orient. Short samples cannot certify nuanced stick control or sustained two-thumb feel.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, coil targets and upload form a clear sequence, with patrol warnings and shield damage adding pressure. Assisted travel let me pass many threats and finish both runs at last-observed health 100; observed route offered limited need to reposition. This is a scoped experience report, not a causal balance claim or judgment of unseen tactics.
reasons.presentation: Strong teal/amber industrial art direction, rain, readable weapon silhouette and restrained end-screen layout. Some dark roof/wall regions were nearly black in these captures. Audio was not assessed.
reasons.usability: Brief handbook taught route/recovery and coils; HOLD APPROACH/RECOVER, MEMORY SAVED, OFF and upload confirmations helped. Map selected extraction and showed a route; visible close worked. Repeated NO IMPACT/INERT COVER communicates failure but not always its cause clearly at a glance.
reasons.readability: Core health/ammo and large controls are readable in portrait. Small compass, distant enemies, signs and compact upper HUD demand closer inspection. Announcement overlays sometimes compete with the scene.

specific_observations.note: Manual forward MOVE yielded visible forward travel; lateral/backward/diagonal precision not sampled.
Map clearly showed completed receivers, JAMMER OFF, UPLINK and extraction route. It stayed planning until visibly closed.
AIM produced iron sights; small FIRE drag sampled. Drag sensitivity quality remains uncertain from the brief sample.

uncertainties: Cannot isolate why first TURN did not change heading; no source or internals inspected
Cannot distinguish all NO IMPACT causes from captures alone
No claim that frequent pauses improved game quality or represent human reaction time
No enjoyment inferred for recovered story text, other tools, alternate tactics or unassessed content

interpretation: Both holistic mobile scores remain7/10; no isolated label benefit or human enjoyment certified. Raw reports preserved.
